A working method for building with coding agents

A rule is only a rule when something on the disk can stop you.

design-first is a Claude Code plugin. It asks before it builds, locks each decision in a manifest, and gives every rule an id and a grade that says whether a machine enforces it. A Doctor checks the disk and prints what it found, never what a document says.

{{TOTAL}} rules in the kit. {{HOOKS_N}} stopped by a hook, {{GATES_N}} by a gate, {{HONOUR}} by nothing but the reader. The page says so because the law file says so, and this page is generated from it.

The flow

Six beats. Each one is a real recording from an install on a scratch machine, {{RECORDED}}, kit {{RECORDED_KIT}}. Read down; the terminal keeps pace.

1Interview

The first command, /design-first:adopt, asks seven questions, one at a time, the recommended answer first. Silence is not approval. The command only asks; a script does every write, so the same command can undo it.

commands/adopt.md asks

    {{QUESTIONS}}

2The script writes

Every file the kit writes is listed as it is written, with the reason it exists. The brain is the adopter's private layer: who they are, their own rules, their claims. Nothing about the author of the kit goes in it.

{{T_ADOPT_H}}

{{T_ADOPT}}

3Decide, then map

A project starts with DECISIONS.md, the one record of what was chosen and why, and ARCHITECTURE.md, one page that names every domain and its config file. A later change is a Change Request, never drift. This is the kit's own map.

ARCHITECTURE.md, core flow

{{CORE_FLOW}}

4Build, guarded

While the agent builds, a hook reads every tool call before it runs. A force push is refused. Staging a secrets file is refused. The refusal names the rule, and the rule's grade says HOOK because this is what the grade means.

{{T_GUARD_H}}

{{T_GUARD}}

5The Doctor looks

The Doctor reads the disk, not the documents. On this fresh install it is RED: the new brain has no manifest yet, and the claim that every repository carries one is false. A blank panel beats a wrong number, so it says so.

{{T_DOCTOR_H}}

{{T_DOCTOR}}

6Green means checked

The kit runs the same Doctor on itself. GREEN is printed only from a genuine pass of every claim; a check that could not look never reports green. The state is written to disk, and every finding has a row in the manual.

{{T_KIT_H}}

{{T_KIT}}

The parts

What is in the box, read from the box.

Hooks

Registered in hooks/hooks.json. Each runs under PowerShell 7 before or around a tool call. A hook that errors allows the call, logs it, and says so: fail loud, not fail closed.

    {{HOOK_ROWS}}

The law

One file, law.json, generates LAW.md. Every clause has one owning file, a verb, and a grade the generator derives from the mechanism that enforces it. A missing mechanism prints HONOUR.

    {{GROUP_ROWS}}

The Doctor

Reads claims.json and checks each claim against the disk. Three bands: CLAIMS fail the run, SURVEY reports, COULD-NOT-LOOK is its own exit code and is never a pass. Claim types in the kit's own file:

Install

{{INSTALL}}

Three commands. adopt asks its questions, a script writes the files and runs the Doctor. /design-first:remove reverses exactly what adopt wrote and keeps anything you changed.
